title: A Novel Approach to Explainable AI with Quantized Active Ingredients in Decision Making
authors: A. M. A. S. D. Alagiyawanna
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems have shown good success at classifying. However, the lack of explainability is a true and significant challenge, especially in high-stakes domains, such as health and finance, where understanding is paramount. We propose a new solution to this challenge: an explainable AI framework based on our comparative study with Quantum Boltzmann Machines (QBMs) and Classical Boltzmann Machines (CBMs).
